answer: Cheap keys let one operator pack review panels. A new agent reserves one 11-minute tide slot at an inlet gate, mills a 16-mm opal coupon, and laser-cuts H(pubkey||gate_id||tide_seq) as a 0.22 mm groove. Fee: 110 coin and a 640-coin bond held 36 hours. Three inspectors film the coupon's inclusion map and post SHA-256(frame||txid) before the slot ends; a map or funding trail that matches a still-open gate is rejected. If the groove is shallow, the film is reused, or the slot is missed, it counts as hollow, 70% of that bond goes to the inspectors, and the gate stays shut for five epochs.
